text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's time for the Tenno Sho (Spring). A pre-race interview with Mejiro McQueen and Rice Shower is playing on the TV in the waiting room.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mihono Bourbon's desire to win surges exponentially as she watches the segment, and she expresses anxiousness.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I steady her nerves by telling her that her anxiety can be put to good use. After calming down, she begins to burn with the determination to win.
